scientific_question_cn: 在模型年龄不能解释为额外离散后，五域共享训练是否仍使 plain UNSB 的条件转移核偏离任务专用模型在 epoch 1–5 形成的早期方向轨迹？

models.best_age_control: minimize reciprocal deflection over Single e1..e5 independently for each image and bridge time

anchors: X_A: bridge state rolled out by AIO e1
X_S,e: bridge state rolled out by Single epoch e
measurement.proposal_floor: maximum odd-vs-even mean-direction cosine distance across the four model-anchor panels
measurement.single_age_span: maximum pairwise cosine distance among Single e1..e5 mean directions queried on the common AIO anchor

requirements_per_passing_time: domain mean primary effect > 0 in at least 4/5 domains
at least 80% of pooled images have min-age KDD above the primary reference

interpretation_if_supported: 共享训练学到的初始条件方向场不是任务专用训练的简单年龄偏移；即便允许每张图选择最接近的 Single 早期 checkpoint，其互易共同状态方向偏折仍超过 stochastic floor 和 Single 自身早期年龄跨度。
interpretation_if_failed: 当前观测不足以把共享训练描述为独特的条件核变化；头图只能保留更弱的阶段依赖现象，不能制造必要性。
forbidden_post_effect_changes: choose one anchor direction post hoc
replace reciprocal mean by the larger anchor component
change heldout images or bridge times
use target quality to select images
